sara_people: Quick Q — planning PTO during our rolling year-end shutdown window. If I need 3 days that overlap the partial shutdown, do I submit normally or is there a special flow?

mike_engineering: same question from eng — do managers still need to approve for auto-blocked days?

sara_people: @jordan_manager tagging you for coverage/approval expectations — do we need a separate coverage doc?

jordan_manager: Short answer: submit PTO in Workday like normal. Company shutdown days are auto-blocked but if you want to use PTO (vs unpaid or a floating holiday) put it in the request and add a coverage note. Managers should still approve PTO that overlaps blackout windows. :white_check_mark:

samir_hr: Policy snippet: company schedules a rolling partial shutdown each year (dates posted on the calendar). Employees are auto-blocked for those days; payroll will deduct PTO unless you select unpaid or a floating holiday. For partial overlaps submit a half-day request in Workday. If you need an exception use the People Ops exception form. Link: https://redwood.internal/hr/pto-shutdown

sara_people: thanks — can carryover be applied automatically to cover those blocked days? I have ~8 hours of carryover left.

samir_hr: Carryover can be used but not retroactively after payroll cutoff. Best practice: when you submit the PTO request, choose your carryover bucket in Workday or add a note. Payroll cutoff for year-end is Dec 15 — if you need help before then DM payroll.

mike_engineering: coverage: team is ok with async. @jordan_manager i can swap oncall the week before so sara can be OOO. :raised_hands:

jordan_manager: Please add a short note in the PTO request like: "Coverage: Mike L. covering async; no oncall conflict." Approve after note's in.

sara_people: also — if PTO isn't available, what's the quickest way to mark unpaid for those days?

samir_hr: Submit an unpaid leave request in Workday and put "company shutdown override" as the reason. Manager approval required; HR flags payroll. If it's urgent ping me and I'll expedite. Example request body in Workday: ```Request Type: Unpaid Leave
Dates: 2026-12-27 to 2026-12-29
Reason: company shutdown override / no PTO available```

calendar_bot: Company shutdown events have been auto-added to calendars: 2026-12-24 — 2026-12-28. To request an exception or remove the block, file the shutdown-exception form: https://redwood.internal/hr/shutdown-exception

sara_people: Filing the PTO now with coverage note. Thanks everyone :tada:
